book.name: 1 Koronti
book.title: Pwoo ɗinshee ɗi Pool ran Nen Koronti mo

content: Gwakshik nKaa Seyil nKùm Mo
Ɗyemnaa mo, wen rǝɓet kǝ wu man, gyet puun fun mo jir, mo a nder nluu, kǝ gyet mo jir mo can am Bahar Ɗenaat mo ɗel ryang nɗang Mosis zak.
Gyet mo cìn baptisma mmo jir a ndǝǝn nluu, kǝ ndǝǝn am bahar kaaɗe gyet mo dǝm nɗang Mosis sǝ.
Gyet mo jir, mo se mbiise ɗi gyet Naan shin mmo ɗi nǝ a mǝ Riin.
Gyet mo jir mo shwaa am ɗi Naan shin mmo. Mɓeɗi gyet mo shwaa am ɗi gyet nǝ jì put mɓut jwak. Gyet jwak ɗesǝ nǝ mwaan nɗang mo. Gyet jwak ɗesǝ a Kristi shikáa fir.
Jir kǝsǝ, ɓe baa gyet Naan wur kat retnyit kǝ pak mo kas. Mɓǝmǝnǝ ɓe mo murep ɗes a naaryil.
Yaksǝ, ɓe mbii ɗesǝ mo jir, mo ɗee a mbiikám mumun. Mo gwak mun, mbǝkǝ taji mu coor mbii ɗebish mo, kaaɗe gyet mo cìn sǝ kas.

Taji wu ɗee a nenkum mo, kaaɗe gyet pak mo ndǝǝn mo, mo cìn sǝ kas, kaaɗe mo kǝ ten ran ndǝǝn ɓǝǝt haal mǝ Naan sǝ nǝnee, <<Gurum nǝ mo tong nyil, <<mbǝkǝ mo se gwom kùm, <<kǝ shwaa mwes, <<kǝ mo yool a tǝng mɓe cìn kook.>>
Taji mu cìn ngaa kas, kaaɗe gyet pak mo ndǝǝn mo, mo cìn sǝ, har gurum mo ngal laarvǝl baakun, mo murǝp parpuus mǝndong.
Taji mu kam Daa kas, kaaɗe gyet pak mo ndǝǝn mo, mo cìn sǝ, ɓe har gyet nwòo mo, twe mo.
Taji mǝ chakpwoo nɗoom-nɗoom kas, kaaɗe gyet pak mo ndǝǝn mo, mo cìn sǝ, har mo murǝp nsar kǝ ngulep mǝ muut.
Mbii ɗi gyet nǝ kat mo, nǝ ɗee a mbiikám pee mun ɗi. Mo kǝ ten ran mo, a mbǝkǝ mo gwak mun ɗi, mun ɗe peekyes kǝ ɓit nǝ mo kǝ jì a nkaa mun.
Mɓǝmǝnǝ, ɓe koo a weyi, ɗi wur kǝ pan nnǝ wuɗin kǝ ɗar ɓalɓal, ɓe wur tap, taji wur pal kas.

Baa mee jwaan ɗe nǝn nkat wun ɗi kas, see a ɗi nǝn nkat koor gurum mo jir zak. Naan wur a nguzeen, baa wur nyit kǝ mee jwaan kat wun, ɗe nǝn mmet mɓal fuu kas. Ɗangɓe a shi jwaan nǝ, ɓe nwun nle ar put nǝ ɗi zak, mbǝkǝ wu mak gung jwaan nǝ ɗi.
Mɓǝmǝnǝ ɗyemnaa mo, taji wu seyil nkùm mo kas.
Wen kǝn katpwoo wun, a kaa nen ɗe mo kǝ ɗyen sǝ, Naan wur kǝ ten kám ar nǝ wun sǝ. Mɓǝmǝnǝ, ɓe wu ɓeet kǝ suk, nkaa mbii ɗi wen kǝn sat nǝ.

Katɗang mu mang laaɗaa mǝ Se Tong Ashak ɗi muu pǝlang Naan mɓe nǝ, ɓe baa wu man nǝ, muu ɓàl a káa fun mo ashak kǝ Kristi ndǝǝn toom fir kas aa? Gill aas ɗe muu yilang sǝ, ɓe baa wu man nǝ, muu ɓàl a káa fun ndǝǝn fwoshik Kristi kas aa?
Mɓǝɗǝ gill aas nǝ a mǝndong, ɗi muu yilang nǝ mǝ mu se ashak. Nǝ aasǝ zak, mun ɗi ɗes, ɗangbe mun a nan ɗemǝndong, mbǝɗe muu se a gill aas ɗemǝndong.
Wu pan nkaa nen Iisreal mo ndǝǝn nan, nen ɗi moo se ndǝǝn mbiizuum ɗi mo wus nǝ, ɓe moo ɓal a káa fur kǝ Naan ɗi moo shìn nǝ nwur.
Wen kǝn rǝɓet sat a meyii? Kyet mbiise ɗi moo shìn nkùm, mǝnǝ a mee mbii ee? Koo a kùm nǝ a mee mbii ye?
Hai yo, wen kǝn sat a nǝ, mbii ɗi nenkum moo gap mpee cìn zuum, ɓe moo shìn nǝ a riin ɗebish mo, baa moo shin zuum nǝ a nNaan kas. Baa wen rǝɓet kǝ wu ɓalkaa fuu mo ashak kǝ riin ɗebish mo kas.
Baa wun mmak shwaa mɓut laaɗaa mǝ Daa, kǝ wu waa wu shwaa mɓut laaɗaa mǝ riin ɗebish mo zak kas.
Taji mu cìn mee mbii ɗi nǝn nle kǝ Naan cìn tuup kas. Kyet mun, mu ɓal met wur wo?
Wu Cìn Mbii Mo JirMbǝ Shin Ɗǝɗes nNaan
Gurum mo sat nǝ, <<Mu mak cìn koo meye, ɗi mu rǝɓet.>> Nǝ azeen, ɗangbe baa a mbii mo jir ɗi mo mak ɗik wun koo moo koop nǝ mbǝ gurum kas.
Taji mee gurum tang mbii ɗe mo ret mukáa fin kas. Amma nǝ ret kǝ wur tang a mbii ɗi mo ret mbǝ niyee mo.
Wu se mbii ɗi moo sǝrep mo ndǝǝn lutuk mǝ luwaa mo. Taji wu talpwoo kas, mbǝ pan ɗi nǝ ndǝǝn pǝtuup.
Mɓǝɗǝ mo kǝ ten ran ndǝǝn ɓǝǝt haal Naan nǝnee, <<Yil nǝ kǝ mbii ɗe mo ndǝǝn nǝ jir, mo a mǝ Daa.>>

Katɗang mee gwar ɗi baa wur kǝ shinzeen nDaa Jesu kas, wur pet wun mbǝ sese ashak kǝ wur. Katɗang wuu lap ii, nnǝ wun ndem, ɓe wu se mbii ɗi wu nle a kyeen fuu. Taji wu tal kas, mbǝ pan ɗi nǝ ndǝǝn pǝtuup fuu.
Amma katɗang mee gwe kǝ ten sat nwun nǝnee, <<Mo kǝ ten shin luwaa ɗesǝ nǝ nkùm.>> Ɓe taji wu se luwaa nǝ kas, mbǝ gwar ɗe wu sat pwoo mǝnǝ nwun, kǝ mɓe pan ɗe nǝ ndǝǝn pǝtuup.
Baa a mɓe pan muu mo kas, amma a mɓe pan kǝ gwar nǝ. Mbǝme ɗang pan kǝ mee gurum nǝn ncíi nwen, mbǝ katpee ɗe wen kǝ nǝ, mɓe cìn mbii ɗi wen kǝn rǝɓet yi?
Katɗang wen pǝlang Naan mɓe mbiise fen. Ɓe cirang ɗangɓe gurum moo leshap ɗebuu nkaa wen, mbǝ mbiise ɗi wen kǝn ten pǝlang Naan nkaa nǝ yi?
Mbǝmǝnǝ, ɓe koo a mbii ɗeɗangyi ɗe wuu cìn, koo a se mbiise, koo a shwaa mbiishwaa, ɓe wu cìn mbii mo jir mbǝ shin ɗehai Naan.
Taji wu le kǝ mee gurum canshii kas. Koo ɗang ɗi gwe nǝ a ngu Yahudi koo baa a ngu Yahudi kas, koo ɗi a Ekǝlisya mǝ Naan.
Kaaɗǝ wen kǝn gung mbǝkǝ wen cìn mbii ɗi mo shang ɗi ngurum mo jir. Baa wen kǝn tang a ɗeret mukáa fen kas, ɗangɓe wen kǝn tang a ɗeret mǝ gurum mo ɗes, mbǝkǝ mo kat ɓam wur ɗi.
